utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly quiet on my end too, but I heard they’ve got a repair list going and could use another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s mostly a short list of small fixes so far, nothing huge - things like trim work, loose fittings, and a few repairs where extra hands would help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep an eye out, and I can drop by after errands with anything you still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Appreciate it, Rey. If you can bring those items by, I’ll add them to the list and keep the drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I heard folks are bringing things by this afternoon, but I still need to find out where they want everyone to park and exactly what supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can ask Quinn to bring those details by later.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that should help. I’ll keep an ear out for where folks should park and what they still need dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I think it starts this afternoon, Mina. I’ll confirm the exact time and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school pickup if you send me the details of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly quiet so far, but it sounds like the repair list is underway. I’m still getting updates secondhand, so I’m glad to hear there’s progress.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great. I can take the heavier stuff or whatever’s still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can. Could you remind me what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly just a few small fixes now - plumbing, loose hinges, and some patching. If you want, I can send you the current list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I missed the details too, but Leo said he could send them again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, but I’d still want to know where people should park and what else needs to be dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help spread the word too, and I’ll keep an eye out for folks who’d be willing to show up.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does it start?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard it kicks off this afternoon, but I’m still checking the exact time and where folks should park.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can bring over a few tools and any supplies you still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, perfect, that'd help a lot. I'll take whatever supplies you think we're short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara. I’ve got some tools I can lend if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus. That helps a lot - I’ll bring what still needs doing, and you can fill in whatever tools we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara. Bring the list over and I’ll sort out the missing tools.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
